trial_court: District Judge, Karimganj, Title Divorce Suit No. 48/2015
case_name: Lalit Sinha @ Lalit Madan Sinha vs Smti Sandhya Sinha
facts_of_case: The parties are the husband and wife who got married in 1996. The husband filed a suit for divorce which was dismissed by the trial court. He is now appealing against that decision.

legal_principles.principle: Filing of criminal cases like case under Section 498 (A) of the IPC, which are subsequently dismissed/rejected, is sufficient to be construed as an act of cruelty by the wife.
legal_principles.held: The Hon'ble Apex Court has held that filing of criminal cases like case under Section 498 (A) of the IPC etc. against the husband and the family member and which are subsequently dismissed/rejected, is sufficient to be construed as an act of cruelty by the wife.
cited_cases: Mr. Rani Narasimha Sastry vs Rani Suneela Rani, (2019) SCC online Sc 1595
Lalit Sinha @ Lalit Madan Sinha vs Smti Sandhya Sinha, (2021) X SCC Y

legal_principles.principle: The standard of proof required in a criminal trial and in a civil trial is not the same.
legal_principles.held: Accordingly, the learned District Judge, rejected the plea of cruelty projected by the appellant husband. It was further conclusion of the learned District Judge that decision of Criminal Courts are not binding on Civil Court

outcome.final_order: The final order of the court is not mentioned in this excerpt.
